faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What does the 'Would You Rather' dilemma reveal about decision making?
faq.a1: Forced-choice trade-offs engage dual-process cognition, contrasting rapid intuitive gut reactions (System 1) with deliberate value-based analysis (System 2). They illuminate personal priorities and non-negotiable boundaries.
faq.q2: Why is comparing choices with community percentages psychologically insightful?
faq.a2: Normative feedback highlights pluralistic ignorance and the false consensus effect, demonstrating that what feels self-evident to one person is often viewed completely differently by others across diverse backgrounds.
faq.q3: How can these dilemma questions be used in relationships or teams?
faq.a3: Hypothetical trade-offs serve as low-stakes icebreakers that facilitate meaningful discussions regarding risk tolerance, lifestyle preferences, ethics, and mutual empathy without direct interpersonal conflict.
faq.q4: Are my dilemma choices recorded or shared?
faq.a4: No. Your question responses and game progress remain entirely client-side in your local browser session. No personal answers or user-identifying profiles are ever stored on external servers.
